A little background

A foundation in systems.
A focus on reliability.

I've spent the past six years at MEMX working in DevOps and systems engineering. Before that, I worked at Tradeweb, earned my master's in computer science at NYU, and spent around three years as a Linux engineer in India.

My professional background is in exchange and trading infrastructure. I'm interested in SRE, infrastructure, and systems engineering roles where reliability and performance matter. Alongside that work, I'm exploring AI infrastructure and agent systems through small, reproducible experiments.
